contexts.text: An infant in the street () = nascent Truth.
The streets of the city () = Truths.
Streets () = Truths.

Walking through the streets of a city... and being at the same time in conversation with Spirits, I did not know but that I was wide awake, and saw as at other times; and so I walked on without mistake...
I was in a street of a great city, and saw little children fighting... HH 344.

We will pass the night in the street () = that He as it were wanted to judge from truth... A street, in the Word, has a like signification to a way, namely, truth; for a street is a way in a city. (Compare AE 652:32.)
That street = truth. Illustrated.

The streets of the New Jerusalem = all things of truth which lead to good, or all things of faith which lead to love and charity; and, as truths then become of good, thus transparent from good, it is said the street was gold, as it were transparent glass. (See HH 307:2.)
The midst of the street of it () = the truth of faith through which is good, and which is afterwards from good.
It shall be restored with street and ditch () = that there will then be truth and good. AE 652:22.
Go out quickly into the streets and lanes () = that he should seek everywhere for some genuine truth, that is, truth which shines from good, or that through which good shines. AE 652:31, Explained.
As streets = truths, it was a representative rite... to teach in the streets. Illustrated.
In the Prophets, streets, wherever mentioned, = either truths, or things contrary to truths. Illustrated. AC 2348. AC 2383. AC 2712:2. AC 3134:2. AC 3727:8. AC 7729:4.
The streets of Jerusalem () = the falsities which reign in the Church.
To lie at the head of all the streets () = to be bereaved of all truth. ( = that truths appear to be dispersed. AC 5376:3.) AE 724:19.

A cry over the wine in the streets () = a state of falsity... Streets = the things which lead to truths. ( = lamentation on account of the lack of truth, and the commingling of truth with falsity. AE 652:7.)
Street = the truth of doctrine; in the opposite, the falsity of doctrine.
Thou hast taught in our streets () = to preach truths from the Word of the Lord; for preaching was formerly done in the streets, because streets = the truths of the doctrine of the Church. AE 617:18.
Mourning in the streets () = the vastation of all truths.
Streets = the truths of faith.
Under Way, see this reference.
The street of a city = the truth of doctrine from good. References.
The streets in the Dutch cities are roofed over; and in the streets there are gates. Explained.
Their bodies shall lie upon the street of the great city () = ... (in) the falsities of the doctrine of justification by faith alone. The street = falsity.
Streets, in the Word, = almost the same as ways, because streets are ways in a city. But still streets = the truths or the falsities oi doctrine, because a city = doctrine. Illustrated.

The street of the city was pure gold as it were transparent glass () = that all the truth of the New Church and of its doctrine is in form the good of love inflowing together with light out of Heaven from the Lord... By the street of a city is signified the truth of doctrine of the Church.
In the midst of the street of it was the tree of life () = that in the inmosts of the Truths of doctrine... is the Lord in His Divine love... Street = the truth of doctrine of the Church.
In the afternoon... boys and girls are seen playing in the streets (of that heavenly city).
The streets (of that city of the Iron Age) were irregular.
The streets (of that city of the Age of Iron mixed with Clay) were irregular.
(Series of delights excited with the Angels by the objects seen in the streets by E. S.) See also SE 2784.
(Effect on Spirits of music heard in the streets by E. S.)
I saw an insane woman in the street...
When I was walking in the street they directed my eyes to filth, etc.
While I was walking in the street, suddenly the noisy crowds were not heard. Explained. SE 3604, Explained.
(Horrible cupidities communicated to Emanuel Swedenborg when he was passing through the streets.)
(Emanuel Swedenborg in interior thought in the street.)
(Emanuel Swedenborg remitted into his pristine state when walking in the street.)
Just now, in the street, when speaking with Spirits, it was given to perceive that...
Those objects of sight in the street which were in agreement with the sphere, excited the sight and ideas; the rest are not seen.
I have spoken almost continually about these things in the street with Spirits and Angels...
While I was speaking with Spirits in the street, it was represented that...
I was in the street and saw knives, and, through phantasy, [the idea] was induced that the evil Spirits would cut my throat with them. Described.

Thus when I have spoken with Spirits... in the street, it has been shown me that there are generals which rule the thoughts of man... (which cause him) to see but slightly certain men he meets, and also the street in which he is walking. These objects arise from that General, causing the man to take notice not to strike against another man, or against any obstacles in the street. Explained.
I spoke with Spirits in the street (about the Lord's Providence appearing so confused and scattered in ultimates). Compare AC 6486.
In the street they injected diabolical calumnies against the Lord.
That they reject the doctrinal things of faith... was made evident in the street, by a rod with which they wanted to strike the eye.
I have perceived their venereal cupidities in the street, when I have seen Quaker women...
I have often observed when in the street that they want to throw me under the wheels...
These Spirits, like others, when I walked through the streets... from their not reflecting, observed nothing of the objects before my eyes... although they can see through my eyes. Explained.
When I have counted my footsteps in the street...
I have thought in the street about eating... and have perceived that the Angels thought about Knowledges...

(Such violators) when walking in the streets, appear to have a lucidity on both sides in front of them, which vibrates in accordance with their steps; and sometimes there also appears a flaming fire wandering about them in the streets where they walk...
The left side of the street Nygatan was completely destroyed...
When I have walked in the street of a city, I have been told that the things which had only slightly struck the eye, and which I had scarcely observed... nevertheless adhere, and can be recalled.
To run to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and to seek in the quarters thereof () = to see and explore in the doctrinals of that Church... Streets, and quarters = doctrinals. AE 652:3.
To faint through hunger at the head of all the streets () = to be deprived of spiritual life through a lack of the Knowledges of truth and good. AE 386:14. AE 652:23.
Streets = where there are truths of doctrine. AE 223:13.

The streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets ()... The streets of the city = the truths of doctrine; boys and girls playing in the streets = the affections of truth and good (and their delights, in which those shall abound who live in truths of doctrine). AE 652:12. ( = the truths and goods of innocence glad and rejoicing from doctrinals. AE 863:11.)
The streets of Jerusalem () = the falsities of doctrine of the Church.
To wander blind in the streets () = not to see truths at all. AE 652:10.
The streets of a city = the truths of doctrine. AE 376:15. AE 430:7. AE 652:11.
The streets which shall be trodden down by them () = the truths of doctrine of the Church, which it will completely destroy. AE 652:16.
Not to be Known in the streets () = not to be recognized by genuine truths. AE 652:10.
The streets of Jerusalem () = the truths of the Church.
Streets = Truths.
The streets of Jerusalem () = the truths (of the Church); here, the falsities. ( = the truths of doctrine of the Church. AE 652:14.)
The street of the great city () = the truth and good of doctrine; in the opposite, the falsity and evil of doctrine; for by a street is signified truth leading; in the opposite, falsity leading.

The reason street = the truth of doctrine, and, in the opposite, the falsity of it, is that by way is signified truth leading to good; and, in the opposite, falsity leading to evil; and streets are the ways in a city; and, as a city = doctrine, a street = the truth or the falsity of doctrine.

In the Spiritual World there are cities, and streets in them; and the quality of everyone as to the affection of truth and the derivative intelligence is Known from the place where he dwells in them, and from the streets in which he walks. Enumerated.
As street = where truth leads, it is said, Truth has stumbled in the street ().
As streets and quarters = what is in accord with each one's affection and perception, it is said, the chariots raged in the streets, they ran to and fro in the quarters ().
Streets () = the truths of doctrine which lead to the good of life; or the truths according to which we are to live.
Streets = falsities of doctrine. AE 734:21.
The streets of Jerusalem () = the falsities of doctrine.
Streets () = the exterior things with them.
The head, or beginning, of the streets = entrance to truth, thus all truth.
Streets, and quarters = truths of doctrine and truths of life which lead to intelligence and wisdom. AE 652:29.
As by the streets of a city are signified the truths of doctrine according to which we are to live, it was customary to teach and to pray in the streets. Illustrated.
As streets = where falsities are (it was customary with them to cast out the slain into the ways and streets). Illustrated.
Street = the truth of doctrine. AE 727:9. AE 734:18. AE 750:13.
